summary: Connect role needs to learning pathways, development plans, and transfer measures. Explore the five-day course and plan your next step.
lede: Workforce planning and development connects role requirements with the capabilities people need to build and apply at work. For HR business partners, talent specialists, and learning professionals, it offers a practical way to turn workforce needs into development plans by reviewing role profiles, diagnosing skills gaps, and mapping learning pathways. Participants also practise designing interventions with ADDIE and evaluating learning transfer using the Kirkpatrick Model.
audienceIntro: This foundation-level course is designed for people who connect workforce capability needs with employee development, learning activity, and role progression. It suits professionals who need a practical method for turning role requirements into development plans and reviewing whether those plans support work priorities.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with job roles, employee development, or workplace learning processes will help you apply the exercises. No programming experience is required.
